decisions.reason: The position covers removal and disposal of existing pipework. Containers are provided only to carry out the disposal.
The position covers suction removal and disposal of existing dolomite filter media, with no replacement media supplied.
The position covers removal and disposal of existing filter support layers, with no replacement material supplied.
The position covers temporary provision of disposal containers and waste batch analysis, not purchase of containers.
The contractor must supply and install new potable-water booster pumps.

items.material_name: Close-coupled centrifugal potable-water booster pump, DN 80 suction × DN 65 discharge, PN 16, 1.5 kW IE3, 60 m³/h at 6.30 m head, EN-GJL-200 impeller
items.description: Foundation-mounted pump with a bellows mechanical seal, IP55 motor and compatibility with a separately provided variable-frequency drive.

decisions.reason: The contractor must provide new steel support frames for mounting the pumps 30 cm above the floor.

items.material_name: Steel-section and threaded-rod booster pump support frame, 30 cm mounting height, concrete infill type
items.description: Floor-anchored frame supports the booster pump before the concrete foundation is poured.

decisions.reason: The contractor must supply and install a new motive-water pump.

decisions.reason: The contractor must provide a new steel support frame for mounting the motive-water pump approximately 50 cm above the floor.

items.material_name: Steel-section and threaded-rod motive-water pump support frame, approximately 50 cm mounting height, concrete infill type
